rationale: Builds directly on the 9x512 recurrent-tail best while staying compile-stable and size-safe. The new recurrent-pass-only attn/MLP log-scales let the second pass rebalance reused tail blocks without changing first-pass behavior, which targets an unspent structural knob on the proven recurrent path rather than repeating output-head or pure LR sweeps. The added tensors are tiny control-state, remain float-kept under the existing export rules, and preserve the exact final int8+zlib evaluation path.
title: Recurrent Tail Sublayer Rebalancing
